title: meeting-key-and-source-set
description: The pairing result: one opaque meeting key and the transcript set it currently binds. The pairing rule lives in goal.md clause 16 and is never restated here.

content-entity.description: the routing entity a model picked from the meeting's CONTENT when no declarative route matched (owner ruling r-route-by-content-not-account, 2026-09-27); present only when a pick was made

meeting-key.description: opaque identity of one meeting; minted by the detection cycle, compared for equality only, never parsed

source-set.description: every transcript currently paired to this meeting
